# File Handoff Service (FHS)

> FHS is a single-use, zero-retention file relay built on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects. An upload returns one handoff URL; the receiver downloads the bytes once and they are dropped from volatile memory. No R2, KV, D1, or Durable Object storage.

- Canonical page: https://spuds0588.github.io/File-Handoff-Service-FHS-/
- Source: https://github.com/Spuds0588/File-Handoff-Service-FHS-
- License: MIT
- Author: Corey Burns. GitHub: https://github.com/Spuds0588 · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/coreytburns/
- Platform: Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects (free plan works)

## What it does

- `POST /upload` accepts a binary body and returns a random token plus a single-use handoff URL.
- `GET /retrieve/:token` streams the payload once, then burns the token. Later requests receive HTTP 410.
- Payloads are split into 8 MB chunks, one Durable Object each, and only ever exist in isolate memory.
- The TTL clock starts when the upload is sealed: 60 seconds by default, 5 to 3600 configurable.
- Default payload ceiling is 25 MB; configurable up to 90 MB, under the Workers 100 MB request-body limit.
- Open-by-default, independently configurable controls for upload and retrieve: domain allowlists and optional bearer secrets, plus upload-only payload-size and MIME-type filters.

## What it is for

Backend-to-backend transfer of NPI, PHI, or confidential artifacts where neither system should share storage, credentials, or a third-party data store. It replaces shared buckets, long-lived signed URLs, and "email the file" workflows for short, one-time handoffs.

It is not a file store, a queue, or a workflow engine. It is not durable: if the consumer misses the window, re-upload.

## API

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/` | JSON descriptor with live limits, filters, and auth requirements |
| POST | `/upload` | Body is the file; returns 201 with token and handoffUrl |
| GET | `/retrieve/:token` | Streams the file once (200); afterwards 410 |

Upload response fields: `token`, `handoffUrl`, `contentType`, `totalBytes`, `totalChunks`, `expiresInSeconds`, `expiresAt`.

Status codes: 201 sealed, 400 malformed token, 401 when `UPLOAD_SECRET` or `RETRIEVE_SECRET` is set and the bearer token is missing, 403 disallowed browser origin, 405 wrong method, 410 expired or already consumed, 413 over the payload cap, 415 disallowed content type, 500 internal error.

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TTL_SECONDS` | 60 | 5 to 3600 |
| `MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` | 26214400 (25 MB) | 1024 to 94371840 (90 MB) |
| `CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES` | 8388608 (8 MB) | 65536 to 16777216 |
| `ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES` | unset (any) | upload only; comma-separated MIME types; `image/*` wildcard; blocked uploads get 415 |
| `ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DOMAINS` | unset (any) | upload-only browser Origin/Referer hostnames; `*.example.com`; blocked uploads get 403 |
| `ALLOWED_RETRIEVE_DOMAINS` | unset (any) | retrieve-only browser Origin/Referer hostnames; `*.example.com`; blocked retrievals get 403 |
| `UPLOAD_SECRET` | unset | any string; gates POST /upload only; set with `wrangler secret put` |
| `RETRIEVE_SECRET` | unset | any string; gates GET /retrieve/:token only; set with `wrangler secret put` |

Upload and retrieve filters are independent and open by default. Domain checks only govern browser Origin/Referer, while `UPLOAD_SECRET` and `RETRIEVE_SECRET` are real bearer gates.

## Deploy

One-click deploy (clones into your GitHub account, provisions the Durable Object, no required fields; set `UPLOAD_SECRET` and/or `RETRIEVE_SECRET` after deploy):
https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/Spuds0588/File-Handoff-Service-FHS-

From an agent working in another repository, without adding files or secrets to it:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spuds0588/File-Handoff-Service-FHS-/main/scripts/setup.mjs

The script uses a temporary checkout, writes the generated upload secret to `~/.fhs/upload-secret` (mode 600), verifies upload/retrieve/410, and removes the checkout. It does not manage `RETRIEVE_SECRET`; set that separately if you want to gate retrieval.

Or from the CLI:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Spuds0588/File-Handoff-Service-FHS-.git fhs
cd fhs
npm install
npx wrangler login
npx wrangler deploy
```

`wrangler deploy` prints the `workers.dev` base URL. The Durable Object binding and the `v1` migration are already in `wrangler.jsonc`, so there are no prompts or manual bindings.

Local verification needs no Cloudflare account:

```bash
npm test
```

Repository rules, invariants, and development environment cleanup steps live in `AGENTS.md`. Work log and backlog are in `history.md` and `todo.md`.
